extracted.name: Peanut Sauce
extracted.description: This peanut sauce recipe is super easy to stir together—no blender or food processor required! It's creamy, nutty, savory, and bright. We love it as a dipping sauce and on noodles, grain bowls, and more.
ingredient_lines: ½ cup creamy natural peanut butter
instruction_lines: In a medium bowl, stir together the peanut butter, lime juice, rice vinegar, sriracha, tamari, sesame oil, maple syrup, ginger, and 4 tablespoons of the water. If the sauce is too thick, add more water, 1 tablespoon at a time, until it reaches your desired consistency.
Use as a dipping sauce for spring rolls or on peanut noodles. Find additional serving suggestions in the blog post above.
